title: Sunday Cabbage Tacos
description: A delicious twist on traditional tacos, featuring sautéed cabbage and a hint of Mexican flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Mexican hot sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the cabbage mixture onto a tortilla and serving.
